notes.title: 🌊 Swim with us toward World Ocean Day Festival and help us save marine life! 🐳
notes.content:
[h3] The ocean is cruicial for our entire planet's ecosystems, producing more oxygen and absorbing more carbon than all the forests combined 💧 This event is all about protecting it and its many incredible inhabitants. [/h3]

World Ocean Day Festival is an event by Games For Waves, gaming and streaming community created by Whale and Dolphin Conservation. The goal? To connect gaming industry with real-world conservation efforts. The festival kicks off today and Untold Tales joins in with [b]Bee Simulator + Everdream Valley bundle[/b] and many other titles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/1100d557d97384564b6d41b5b928ce40cf02a4ba.png[/img]

🗓️ From June 5th to 12th, [b]we're pledging 20% of our net profits to Whale and Dolphin Conservation[/b] and you get to purchase our games, Bee Simulator + Everdream Valley bundle included, at [i]deep[/i] discounts. This year, every purchase WDC to protect the ocean and the seas from deadly lost and discarded fishing gear! 🛶🎣🐟
[previewyoutube=7TmAZSZtikA;full][/previewyoutube]
 [h2][b]About Bee Simulator + Everdream Valley bundle[/b][/h2]

Buzz through nature’s wonders by day, dream magical adventures by night!

In Bee Simulator, step into the tiny yet daring world of a heroic honeybee. Explore a vibrant ecosystem, collect pollen, and take on fierce wasps to protect your hive. Whether you're flying solo or teaming up in split-screen co-op, this buzzing adventure promises action, teamwork, and the thrill of nature from a bee’s-eye view.

Then, let the magic of Everdream Valley sweep you away as you transform an old farm into a charming paradise. Tend to crops, care for adorable animals, and discover the wonders of the valley. But the adventure doesn't stop at sunset—dreams turn into playful, magical escapades as you inhabit the creatures of the night. Play solo or with friends in co-op mode and create unforgettable memories in this enchanting farming adventure.

💦 So, are you ready to dive in? Support marine life and celebrate the ocean with Bee Simulator + Everdream Valley bundle:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47967/Bee_Simulator__Everdream_Valley/ 

...and don't forget to wishlist Bee Simulator: The Hive!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348910/Bee_Simulator_The_Hive/

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello members of the hive,

We are pleased to tell you that the development team has been working on a small update to fix some issues addressed by the community.

[h2]General Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Achievements are now available for Bee Simulator
[*] Gamepad support added for Xbox Controller, Switch Controller Pro, Dualshock 4, Dualsense, Directinput Controller, Steam Controller
[/list]

See you inside the beehive!
